description.value: Minos Greek Souvlaki Restaurant has been a Kamloops institution since 1982, serving authentic Greek cuisine under chef Tasso, whose 30-plus years of experience and signature meat marinade have earned it the self-proclaimed title of 'Kamloops No.1 Greek Restaurant.' The menu spans souvlaki, calamari, spanakopita, fresh Greek salads, pasta, and seafood, with a full dine-in atmosphere as well as pickup service. The restaurant also offers custom catering for events ranging from 15 to 200 guests.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website was successfully fetched and corroborates the OSM address and business identity exactly. Takeout is confirmed by the prominent 'Pick Up Orders: 250-376-2010' callout on every page. No bike parking, bike racks, washroom access, or cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site or in the OSM tags; the only parking note ('Limited parking & entrance at the back') refers to vehicles.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; phone (250-376-2010) was sourced from the website only, so contact_confirmed.phone is null.
No bike parking or rack information found on the website or in OSM tags; this is a key WWC criterion that will need on-the-ground verification.
Contact page notes 'Limited parking & entrance at the back' — cyclists should be aware access may be via a rear entrance.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A long-established, actively operating full-service Greek restaurant with takeout available — a solid meal stop for touring cyclists in Kamloops, though bike-specific amenities are unconfirmed.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes multiple vegetarian items: spanakopita, pita & tzatziki, pita & hummus, small and large Greek salads, and calamari. No explicit vegan or GF labeling observed
